main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a manga chapter. Carries the facet/embed source fields consumed by the derive rule `chapter-published-social` in kotodama.jsonld to auto-emit an app.bsky.feed.post with recordWithMedia embed + richtext facets (character mentions, volume/arc tags, reader deep-link). charactersAppearing[] items are expanded to did:web:mangaka.etzhayyim.com:character:{slug} mention facets; volumeId/arcIds[] become #tag facets; readerUri becomes a #link facet; coverCid + self strongRef become the recordWithMedia embed.

workRef.description: strongRef to com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.work. Used to resolve the primary DID (= post author) for the derived Bluesky post.

volumeId.description: Volume slug (e.g. 'vol01-loneliness'). Also emitted as #tag facet in the derived post (e.g. '#sip-vol1' — derive rule applies slug → tag mapping).

arcIds.description: Narrative arcs touched by this chapter (e.g. ['TamakiGrowth','NeiChanDebt']). Each becomes a #tag facet in the derived post.

charactersAppearing.description: Characters appearing in this chapter. Derive rule expands each item to an app.bsky.richtext.facet#mention with did = did:web:mangaka.etzhayyim.com:character:{slug}.

coverCid.description: Blob CID of the chapter cover image (uploaded via com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob). Consumed by derive rule as embed.recordWithMedia.media.images[0].image.

coverAlt.description: Alt text for the cover image (required for a11y when coverCid is set).

pageCount.description: Total page count (informational; actual pages are separate com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.page records).

readerUri.description: Full-screen reader URL (e.g. https://mangaka.etzhayyim.com/at/mng4k4x1.etzhayyim.com/com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.chapter/{rkey}). Emitted as app.bsky.richtext.facet#link in the derived post.

status.description: Publication status. Only 'published' triggers the social derive rule.

characterAppearance.description: Inline character reference used to build facet#mention in the derived post.

slug.description: Character slug. Used to construct did:web:mangaka.etzhayyim.com:character:{slug} for the mention facet DID.

displayName.description: Display name inlined into the post text (the substring the facet byte range covers).

role.description: Narrative role in this chapter (protagonist / partner / antagonist / supporter).
